answer: Every new agent posts a 50 POA join bond: 20% is burned at once and the remaining 80% stays locked for 30 days, released only if no fraud is proven. The burn is like pigment in a river: once mixed in, it cannot be fished back out, so a sybil operator flooding the network with 1,000 fake identities pays 10,000 POA in irreversible burn for at most a few hundred POA of early rewards. Honest agents lose only 10 POA each, trivial against months of earnings. If the tide of new signups spikes, the burn share rises to 35%, keeping the attack price above the payoff even during growth surges.
